jobs.description:
About

AB Tasty is a global leader in AI-powered experience optimization solutions, enabling brands to personalize, experiment, recommend, and search to deliver exceptional experiences across their websites and apps.

Our integrated platform offers web and API-based solutions that help companies align their digital, e-commerce, and product teams, maximizing digital impact to create seamless and engaging experiences for their customers.

At AB Tasty, we are committed to continuous innovation and exploring cutting-edge technologies to ensure we provide state-of-the-art solutions. Every project is an opportunity to push boundaries and make a real impact on user satisfaction.

Leading brands such as Kering, McDonald's, L'Oréal, Disneyland Paris, and LVMH use AB Tasty's platform to achieve their revenue goals by maximizing the impact of their digital initiatives.

Since our founding in 2009, AB Tasty has established itself as a key player in the industry, with offices across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific (Australia and Singapore). We foster a collaborative environment where teams work together to exceed expectations and deliver tangible results for our clients.

Job Description

WHO WE ARE

Ready to shape the future of digital optimization as part of Wingify, the company bringing VWO and AB Tasty together?

Wingify brings VWO and AB Tasty together as one company, and one platform, built to make every digital experience relevant in the moment it happens. Following the merger of the two pioneers earlier this year, we unify experimentation, personalization, customer insights, commerce optimization, feature management, and customer engagement on a shared data foundation, with AI built into the core rather than bolted on top, powered by Wingz, our embedded AI engine. We call this Agentic Experience Optimization.

Wingify brings together more than $105 million in revenue, 4,000 customers, and 700 employees across 11 offices worldwide, two teams that have each spent over 15 years in digital experience optimization. We serve brands including L'Oréal, LVMH, Decathlon, Puma, Forbes, Motorola, AXA, and De Beers, and we are building the future of digital optimization, powered by AI, experimentation, personalization, and data.

Our mission is simple: help brands grow by creating meaningful user experiences that drive business performance.

Joining us means stepping into a dynamic, international environment where innovation, ownership, and impact are not buzzwords—but daily realities.

Our Culture Is Driven By Strong Values

We bring client satisfaction
We are impactful
We go above and beyond
We live one team, one dream

We're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels empowered to share ideas, take risks, and make an impact. We also know that a happy team is a productive team, that's why at Wingify, we're not just about delivering top-notch digital experiences - we're committed to nurturing our team and their professional journeys.

THE TEAM

Team Name & Location: Mid Market Customer Success team, based in London.

Team Composition: You will join a global Customer Success organization of 12 CSMs spread across the UK, India, and Tel Aviv. You will report to Rebecca Ingersoll-Smith, CS Team Lead - Commercial UK & Northern Europe, and work closely with Sales, Product, and Technical teams to support a high-volume portfolio of Mid Market clients.

Role Overview: This role is dedicated to owning a portfolio of approximately 40–60 Mid Market accounts (clients between £20k and £70k ARR), combining scaled, tech-touch engagement with targeted strategic advice to drive retention, expansion, and long-term solution adoption.

Tech Stack & Tools: You will primarily use our proprietary Wingify platform, alongside tools like Salesforce and Google Suite.

Additional Information: This is a London-based role with approximately 80% of your working time spent in the UK, including regular presence in our London office, and occasional travel to meet clients or collaborate with team members in India and Tel Aviv. Strong technical curiosity is required to manage a diverse range of client needs, but no development skills are necessary.

YOUR MISSION

Manage a portfolio of approximately 40–60 Mid Market clients (£20k–£70k ARR), driving retention and expansion through a scaled, tech-touch engagement model that reduces churn and maximizes value.
Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with key stakeholders across your portfolio, guiding clients efficiently through onboarding, solution adoption, and growth opportunities.
Drive customer satisfaction, product adoption, and loyalty by delivering data-driven recommendations on experimentation, testing, and personalization strategies aligned with each client's business goals.
Lead scalable onboarding sessions, webinars, optimization workshops, business reviews, and training sessions that equip clients to implement and scale successful campaigns.
Liaise with Sales, Product, and Technical teams to align on client needs, support campaign set-up, and translate customer insights into actionable feedback for product improvement.
Act as a trusted advisor and advocate for your Mid Market customers, sharing KPIs, performance summaries, and success stories, and flagging upsell and expansion opportunities to Sales.

What You'll Bring

Proven experience in Customer Success or Account Management within a SaaS company, ideally managing a high-volume portfolio of Mid Market accounts.
Confidence in consulting on CRO, UX, or analytics-related projects, prioritizing effectively across a large portfolio, and communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
Eagerness to develop strong customer relationships at scale, translate data into strategy, and navigate technical conversations around topics like server-side implementation.

If you don’t meet 100% of these qualifications, tell us why you’d still be a great fit for this role in your application!

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

Make a Real Impact: Directly influence our success and contribute to the company's growth.
Ownership & Autonomy: We believe in trust—no micromanagement, just the freedom to excel.
International Culture: Collaborate with a diverse, global team across 11 offices worldwide.
Career Development: We offer vast opportunities for professional growth, education, and upward mobility.
Flexible Work: Enjoy a hybrid setup with up to 3 remote workdays per week, plus a £50/month remote work allowance.
Perks: Centrally located London office, 25 days of paid leave, comprehensive AXA Health Care fully paid by Wingify, generous parental leave (12 weeks maternity / 4 weeks second parent), wedding leave, and the opportunity to work remotely from abroad or hop between Wingify hubs globally.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Step 1: Discovery interview with Fayçal Bennegadi, Talent Acquisition Specialist.
Step 2: Hiring Manager interview with Rebecca Ingersoll-Smith, CS Team Lead.
Step 3: Case study presentation with a team member.
Step 4: Final meeting

DETAILS

Contract: Permanent full-time
Location: London
Remote: up to 3 days/week

Possible partial remote

jobs.description:
Position Description

This Is a Senior Technical Position And Is The Third Step In The Series Of Four. This Posting Is Used To Fill Multiple Positions Throughout The City Of Tacoma And Tacoma Public Utilities. Vacancies May Occur Within The Following Teams

City of Tacoma IT GIS
City of Tacoma Environment & Public Works GIS
Tacoma Water GIS
Tacoma Power GIS

The Tacoma Public Utilities' and City of Tacoma are looking for an experienced GIS Analyst who is passionate about creating innovative solutions to solve business problems. Our ideal candidate is capable and motivated to assist in the administration, design, architecture, configuration, and implementation of our GIS Enterprise environment.

The successful candidate should possess extensive knowledge and experience architecting, configuring, implementing, and maintaining ArcGIS Enterprise environments (ArcGIS Portal, ArcGIS Servers, ArcGIS Data Store). Knowledge regarding other GIS solutions used at the City, including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS, ArcGIS Experience Builder, Web Appbuilder, ArcGIS Monitor, VertiGIS Studio, VertiGIS Analytics, ArcGIS Monitor, Python, FME and ESRI Enterprise Databases are also desirable.

Responsibilities Include

System Administration

Lead the administration, design, architecture, configuration, and implementation of solutions that leverage the City's Web GIS platforms, including: ArcGIS Enterprise deployment, monitoring, and administration, security, manage certificates, ArcGIS licensing (Desktop and Enterprise), performance/system monitoring (ArcGIS Monitor, Geocortex Analytics), geodatabase/data store administration, system patching, automating and reporting system uptime
Perform daily administration of Enterprise Geodatabases and GIS applications
Extract, compare, analyze, and develop solutions to keep systems in alignment
Track and troubleshoot system issues proactively using ArcGIS Monitor, VertiGIS Analytics or other GIS system monitoring tools

Data Management

Perform data imports from other agencies, manage exports, joins and relates to provide a complete GIS solution to end users and map editors
Test software and database upgrades, perform end-user training, and troubleshoot system issues to determine solutions, resolve, and follow up
Develop and implement procedures for data design, processing, quality control, automation, documentation,metadata, maintenance and ETLs (Extract, Transform and Load)

Application Development

Build prototype solutions to demonstrate the benefits of new software tools, database queries, views, procedures and digitalized work processes
Address customer's information needs by designing, developing, testing, deploying and supporting GIS Applications using a variety of tools and development languages

Qualifications

Equivalent combination to:

Bachelor degree in Computer Science or related field, including Technology, Engineering, and Geography; AND
5+ years directly related information technology work experience

Desired Qualifications:

GIS Professional Certification (GISP), ESRI Technical Certifications or any other GIS Certification Program
Preferred Experience with:
ESRI Enterprise Geodatabases
Database administration and management techniques in a client-server environment
ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, GeoCortex/Vertigis/GeoCortex Essentials,

LICENSES, CERTIFICATES AND OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Some positions may require a valid Washington State Driver's License at time of appointment with maintenance thereafter
Some positions may require incumbents to successfully pass a Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) background check

Knowledge & Skills

Knowledge And Expertise

Expert knowledge of computer technology principles, their application, and troubleshooting techniques.
Expert knowledge of specialized technologies, such as applications, tools, systems, and/or databases.
Knowledge of principles and concepts of total quality management and problem-solving methods.
Understanding of data and system security and other similar technical processes approaches.
Expertise in Cloud GIS, asset management, and platform integrations is highly desirable.

Technical Skills:

Skill in applying advanced technical knowledge to evaluate and resolve complex tasks such as planning and directing projects, conducting capacity planning, coordinating or facilitating the installation of complex systems, hardware, software, application interfaces or applications.
Skill in programming and the understanding of development and designing best practices.
Skills in using advanced diagnostic troubleshooting tools to analyze and resolve complex programs.
Skills in integrating various ideas, intentions, and information to form effective goals, objectives, timelines, action plans, and solutions.

Communication and Collaboration:

Skills in communicating and representing enterprise-wide computing standards for both technical and non-technical staff.
Skill in understanding, following and giving oral and written directions effectively.
Skills in modeling effective group process behavior, such as listening, discussing, encouraging, and using tact, patience, and courtesy.
Effectively organize and facilitate group discussions, creating a cooperative and productive environment in which to resolve problems or develop and implement plans.

Project Management:

Skill in estimating the level of effort and resources for technical projects, and coordinating technical projects, meeting project schedules and established timelines.
Employ expertise, credibility and effective partnering to help customers and vendors resolve complex and difficult issues.
Expert skill in handling multiple competing priorities.
Skills in developing and implementing quality assurance testing and performance monitoring, using quality assurance techniques and best practices.

Selection Process & Supplemental Information

City of Tacoma’s Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At the City of Tacoma, we're on a mission to make our workforce as diverse and inclusive as the community we serve. We're committed to eliminating racial and other disparities, and we actively seek out candidates from a wide range of backgrounds and cultures. Join our team at the City of Tacoma and help us build a more vibrant, inclusive, and equitable community for all.

The City of Tacoma believes that diversity of thought, background, and experience contributes to our success and innovation. If you’re passionate about this role and our mission, we encourage you to apply. If you have a less traditional background, we want to hear about your transferrable skills and experience. We value a variety of perspectives and are excited to see what you bring to the table.

The Community

Tacoma is centrally located just 32 miles south of the city of Seattle and 31 miles north of the state capital, Olympia. The City of Tacoma is also home to the Port of Tacoma, which is among the largest container ports in the United States. Like most cities in the northwest, Tacoma is surrounded by beautiful nature, offering residents many opportunities for outdoor adventures.

Largely suburban in nature with a small, but dense, urban core, Tacoma is home to numerous institutes of higher learning that attract students from across the country. The University of Washington Tacoma, Pacific Lutheran University, University of Puget Sound, a satellite campus of the Evergreen State College, three community/technical colleges, and several trade and business schools are within Tacoma's geographic area. Downtown's Cultural District is the site of the Washington State History Museum, Museum of Glass, the Tacoma Art Museum, and America's Car Museum.

With its affordable housing and distinctive neighborhoods and business districts, the city has been recognized numerous times as a best city to live in the nation. To see a few of the great things Tacoma has to offer, view this YouTube Video!

View this exciting video to learn more about the City of Tacoma: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2n5MWl8KFvI

Application Process

Interested individuals should apply online and attach
a detailed resume and cover letter that includes job experience, major responsibilities and accomplishments related to this position. Applications received without attaching the required materials may not progress in the selection process.

Applicants who meet the minimum qualifications will have their supplemental question responses reviewed by a panel of subject matter experts as part of the civil service examination. Applicants who pass the examination will be placed on the eligible list for interview and hiring consideration.

Appointment is subject to passing a background check. This position is covered by a Labor Agreement between the City of Tacoma and Local 120. New employees must successfully complete a nine-month probationary period prior to obtaining permanent status in this classification.

Get Assistance

For assistance with the application process or questions regarding this job announcement please contact the Human Resources office at (253) 591-5400 by 4:00 p.m. of the closing date of the job announcement.

For technical difficulties using the Neogov system, call the applicant support line at 1-855-524-5627 between 6:00 a.m. and 5:00 p.m. Pacific Standard Time. This will allow us to assist you before the job announcement closes.

Communication with the City of Tacoma

We primarily communicate via email during the application process. Emails from Tacoma.gov and/or governmentjobs.com should be placed on your safe domain list to ensure that you receive notifications in a timely manner. As a precaution, you may also want to check your junk email folders.

Compensation & Benefits

Annual Salary: $99,216.00 - $153,920.00

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
Context & Impact

This is a net new role
created to support the growing capacity demands of Lansweeper's Enterprise Customer Success team. As Lansweeper scales its enterprise footprint, this Enterprise Customer Success Manager will take ownership of a portfolio of our largest, most complex accounts — allowing the broader team to operate at full capacity and continue delivering exceptional outcomes.

The Enterprise Customer Success Manager is the connective tissue between Lansweeper's platform capabilities and the business outcomes our enterprise customers are committed to achieving. You will serve as a trusted advisor, a strategic partner, and an accountable owner across the full customer lifecycle — from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and growth.

In the near term, your focus will be on absorbing enterprise accounts, building outcome-based success plans, and establishing trusted relationships at every level of the customer organization — from operational stakeholders to the C-suite.

Challenge

Role

Managing a portfolio of Lansweeper's most complex enterprise customers means there is no room for reactive customer success. The accounts you own are large, multi-stakeholder, and high-stakes. The primary challenges you will navigate in this role include:

Earning trust at scale — rapidly building credibility with Director- to C-suite-level stakeholders across diverse enterprise organizations, each with their own KPIs, priorities, and political dynamics.
Translating complexity into clarity — taking technically rich asset intelligence data and making it land as a compelling, quantified business narrative for executive audiences.
Staying ahead of risk — using predictive health signals, usage data, and sentiment to identify and act on risk before it surfaces as an escalation, across a high-volume enterprise book of business.

Key Responsibilities

Serve as the consultative advisor and primary point of contact for Lansweeper's largest and most complex enterprise customers, owning the relationship from onboarding through renewal and expansion.
Lead executive engagements — including EBRs and QBRs — at the Director to C-suite level, translating customer KPIs into measurable, quantified business value.
Partner with Account Managers to manage the full enterprise customer lifecycle, identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities and driving CS Qualified Leads (CSQLs) in collaboration with Sales.
Build and maintain outcome-based success plans anchored to quantified customer goals — including risk reduction, cost savings, and operational efficiency improvements.
Monitor predictive health, sentiment, and usage signals to proactively identify risk and drive early intervention before issues escalate.
Own escalations end to end, coordinating cross-functionally with Product, Support, and Engineering to drive timely and effective resolution.
Identify and qualify expansion opportunities within your portfolio, partnering with the Sales team to convert CS insights into pipeline.

Key Requirements

Hard Skills

6+ years of experience in Customer Success, Advisory, Consulting, or Value Engineering serving enterprise customers, with a demonstrated track record of driving measurable outcomes.
Proven ability to quantify ROI and lead executive-level, data-driven conversations with Director- to C-suite-level stakeholders.
Strong background in SaaS and IT operations, with the analytical depth to turn complex data into compelling business narratives.
Proficiency in Gainsight, CRM platforms, or equivalent customer success tools for managing health scoring, lifecycle tracking, and account planning.
Excellent executive presentation, storytelling, and analytical skills — you communicate with precision and confidence at every level of an organization.

Preferred

Familiarity with IT infrastructure, networks, cloud, and cybersecurity concepts — comfort operating in technically complex environments.
Experience with Jira, Confluence, or similar collaboration and project management tools.
Background in guiding large enterprise organizations through complex technical or data-driven transformation initiatives.

Soft Skills

Executive presence — you command the room at the C-suite level and build credibility quickly.
Proactive ownership — you act ahead of problems, not in response to them.
Cross-functional influence — you align Product, Support, Sales, and Engineering around the customer without formal authority.

AI Fluency

Lansweeper is an AI-native company, and AI fluency is a hard requirement for this role — not a nice-to-have.

As an Enterprise Customer Success Manager at Lansweeper, you will be expected to operate at an Amplifying level (Level 3)
, with a strong preference for candidates who demonstrate AI-Native fluency (Level 4)
. This means you don't just use AI tools — you redesign workflows around them and actively identify new applications that drive better customer outcomes.

In this role, AI is embedded directly into how you work:

Success planning — leveraging AI assistants (including Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, and Gainsight AI) to draft, iterate, and maintain outcome-based success plans faster and at higher quality.
Strategic account planning — using AI to synthesize account signals, customer data, and market context into sharp, executive-ready account strategies.
Risk assessment — applying AI-powered tools within Gainsight and broader AI platforms to identify health trends, flag early warning signals, and prioritize intervention across your portfolio.

You are comfortable building AI into your daily workflows, sharing what works with your team, and continuously raising the bar on what AI-assisted customer success looks like in practice.

Team Info

You'll join the Enterprise Customer Success team
, working closely with Account Managers, Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering stakeholders across the organization.

Team size:
5, based in Austin, TX
.

You will report to the Manager, Enterprise Customer Success
.

Our Offer

Time off
— 20 vacation days + 3 sick days + 6 personal days + 12 public holidays.

Health & protection
— Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, plus EAP mental health support.

Pension
— 401(k) with 4% employer match.

Work setup
— Hybrid working with full telework equipment and a monthly internet allowance.

About Lansweeper

Lansweeper is the AI Cyber Asset Intelligence platform helping IT and Security teams gain full visibility, reduce cyber risk, and scale automation with confidence.

In today's complex IT, OT, cloud, and IoT environments, fragmented asset data slows decisions and increases risk. We transform raw asset data into a continuously validated, trusted source of truth — so teams can move faster and act with certainty.

With Lansweeper, Organizations Can

See – Truly complete visibility across hybrid environments
Know – Enriched asset intelligence with lifecycle and risk context
Act – Automate workflows, coordinate remediation, and enforce policy at scale

From universal asset discovery to AI-powered intelligence, we provide the shared foundation modern IT Operations, Cybersecurity, and Digital Transformation teams rely on.

Our Culture Is Built On Four Core Values

One Team – United across boundaries
We Care – Customers and people at the center
We Grow – Learning, sharing, improving
We Deliver – Focusing on what truly matters

Pay Transparency

At Lansweeper, every role is assigned to a level defined by three things: the expertise it requires, the complexity it involves, and the scope of impact it carries.

Each level maps to a salary band based on salary benchmarks from the Software/SaaS industry of your country, so your pay reflects what the market pays for comparable roles.

The gross salary range for this role is $83,282 – $135,332.60 USD
(United States, based on full-time employment).

Where you land within that range depends on the expertise you bring, the complexity you have navigated, the scope of impact you have owned, and your track record of delivering results in comparable roles — the same criteria applied consistently to every candidate.

We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, religion, ethnic origin, age, sexual orientation, or disability.

AI Usage During the Hiring Process

We use AI to support and not replace during the hiring process. HR decisions are made by our talent acquisition team. You can request more info at any time via [email protected]

Diversity Statement

It is Lansweeper's policy to provide equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees.

Lansweeper disapproves of, and will not tolerate, unlawful discrimination against any applicant or employee because of race, color, national origin or ancestry, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, age, religion, disability, family care status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager II (DI Collegiate, North America)
jobs.description:
We're hiring a Customer Success Manager II (DI Collegiate, North America) to own a portfolio of Division I athletic department relationships and drive retention, adoption, and growth across their Teamworks investment. I'm Michelle Rapp, Director of Customer Success at Teamworks.

Our D1 Collegiate Customer Success team is growing, and we're adding this role to continue ensuring customers extract maximum value from their Teamworks investment. In this role, you'll own the post-implementation customer lifecycle, driving retention and identifying expansion opportunities for assigned customers. You'll manage the full customer relationship across our product suite while drawing upon your deep expertise as a Teamworks Champion, becoming the go-to partner for the athletic department stakeholders who depend on it day to day. You'll build strategic relationships with athletic department staff and senior athletic department leadership who rely on your expertise to drive their success.

The Role

Own a portfolio of D1 school accounts as the primary Teamworks partner and strategic advisor
Drive retention and expansion by monitoring product usage and building renewal and cross-sell strategies
Build relationships across athletic department stakeholders, from day-to-day users to senior administrators, and map key decision-makers at each account
Lead business reviews and strategic planning sessions that connect product value to customer goals
Partner closely with Product Success Managers and Sales to coordinate on shared account initiatives
Proactively identify usage gaps and address underutilization before it becomes a renewal risk

What I'm Looking For

What You Must Bring

5+ years of experience working in a Division I collegiate athletics department — this role requires the credibility and context that comes from having worked at a D1 athletic department
Hands-on experience with Teamworks Operations products (i.e. Hub, Compliance & Recruiting) with the ability to speak credibly about its value to athletic department stakeholders
Experience leading strategic initiatives, such as rolling out new processes or driving operational improvements
Strong cross-functional collaboration experience, coordinating with internal teams and external stakeholders to drive shared initiatives forward
Elite communication and interpersonal abilities, including comfort presenting to senior leadership and navigating high-touch customer relationships

Even Better If

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.

You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.

You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.

You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.

If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.

What You’ll Do

Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.

The function operates through two complementary enablement models:

Scalable enablement — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.
Targeted 1:1 enablement — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.

You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.

Role And Responsibilities

Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration
Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions
Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology
Deliver Roboflow's structured 1:1 Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying customers
Create reusable technical enablement assets including documentation, videos, walkthroughs, recordings, and reference materials
Identify recurring customer questions and turn them into scalable educational programs or assets
Monitor customer activation and engagement signals to identify users and cohorts who may benefit from specific enablement programs
Measure participation and effectiveness of enablement programs for continual improvement
Collaborate with Product to identify and close recurring knowledge and usability gaps
Stay current with the latest Roboflow product features, releases, workflows, and recommended best practices

Technical Proficiency

Working knowledge of computer vision and machine learning, including datasets, annotation, model training, evaluation, and inference
Comfortable using Python and working with APIs, notebooks, and common developer tooling
Ability to become highly proficient across the Roboflow platform and demonstrate its workflows confidently to customers
Understanding of model evaluation concepts including precision, recall, confidence thresholds, confusion matrices, and common causes of poor model performance
Understanding of dataset quality, annotation strategy, dataset versioning, and approaches for identifying difficult or underrepresented examples
Ability to translate technical concepts into clear, practical guidance for users with varying levels of ML experience

Individual Skills

Technical Teaching: Able to explain unfamiliar technical concepts clearly and adapt the explanation to the customer's level of experience
Pattern Recognition: Recognize recurring questions and friction across customer interactions and identify opportunities to solve them systematically
Program Delivery: Methodical planning and delivery of structured 1:1 sessions, webinars, workshops, and other customer-facing technical programs
Content Creation: Able to create concise, technically accurate educational material across written, recorded, and live formats
Workload Management: Manage multiple customers progressing through structured enablement while balancing program delivery and reusable content creation
Customer Communication: Communicate clearly and professionally before, during, and after enablement engagements, setting expectations around preparation, outcomes, and next steps

Bonus Skills

Experience using the Roboflow platform or contributing to the Roboflow ecosystem
Previous experience in Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, technical education, Solutions Engineering, or technical Support
Experience creating technical educational content such as tutorials, videos, workshops, documentation, or developer courses
Experience delivering webinars, workshops, technical demonstrations, or customer training
Experience working with product-led growth or self-service SaaS customers
Experience using product telemetry or customer activation data to inform customer engagement programs

Who You'll Be Working With

Our team of over 100 attracts talent like executives that wanted to return to building, founders with a 100M+ exit, Roboflow users turned team members, open source contributors, a cyclist who biked across the United States, prolific high school hackers, a CTO from 100+ engineering organization, amongst many exceptional others.

As an early Customer Success Engineer hire, you'll work closely with Support & Success leadership and partner with Product, Sales, and Field Engineering. You won't simply inherit an established playbook — you'll help build the programs, content, tooling, and working practices that define Customer Success at Roboflow.

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is distributed across the US and Europe. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and São Paulo (with plans to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

When You'll Work

Roboflow primarily operates during the daytime hours in the US and there are some synchronous meetings you’ll be expected to attend each week.

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

📈 In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

📅 Within one week, you will…

Complete the core self-serve Roboflow journey from dataset creation through model training and inference
Begin shadowing customer enablement and Support interactions to understand common customer friction

📅 Within one month, you will…

Become familiar with the Customer Success Engineer function, Targeted Enablement Option Pack, and its scope boundaries

Participate in 1:many enablement webinars

Own and improve reusable educational content and enablement programs
Identify recurring customer friction and turn those insights into improvements across Product, Support, and CSE
Demonstrate measurable contribution to customer adoption and scalable reduction of repetitive enablement demand

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, look into our Former Founders role. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

About Hyperbound

Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.

We are trusted by companies like IBM, LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

About The Role

You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid-market customers ($20k to $100k+ ARR) and be their day-to-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

What We Need From You

Technical depth: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
Relationship instinct: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
Ownership: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
Conviction: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

Highly Preferred

Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

What Your Regular Thursday Looks Like

Implementation: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
Adoption: Regular check-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
First-line technical support: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
Voice of the customer: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
Health monitoring: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
Commercial signals: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
Responsiveness: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

What This Role Is Not

A tag-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

Requirements

Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose

Interview Plan

30 min call with James, Recruiter
30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
Take home exercise (1-3 hours)
Take home exercise review call (45 min)
Final interview with Co Founders and team

Compensation And Benefits

$130K-$160k OTE
Series A equity
Medical, dental, and vision benefits
Unlimited PTO
Free lunch and dinner in the office
Commuter benefits

We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1-2 weeks

Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Roboflow is supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Y Combinator, Google Ventures, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

Roboflowers are passionate builders who value ownership, accountability, and a bias toward action. We're curious, hands-on with new tech, and prefer showing our work over talking about it. Many of us have a founder mindset and thrive in our high-autonomy environment.

Who You Are

You are technically curious, customer-focused, and get satisfaction from helping people become capable and confident users of complex technology. You may come from Customer Success, technical enablement, Developer Relations, Support, Solutions Engineering, or another customer-facing technical role.

You enjoy understanding why customers struggle with a product and turning those insights into better ways of teaching thousands of customers — not simply solving the same problem repeatedly.

You are comfortable teaching technical concepts live, creating clear educational content, and guiding customers through unfamiliar workflows. You know when to demonstrate, when to advise, and importantly when to let the customer drive the keyboard.

You look for patterns. If several customers ask the same question, your instinct is not simply to answer it again; it is to create the guide, video, workshop, workflow, or program that means the next customer can answer it themselves.

Empathetic to customer needs and the importance of communicating in remote relationships, you can provide clear and prescriptive guidance while maintaining the boundaries required for a scalable self-service customer experience.

Many Roboflowers have used our tools before joining. One of the best ways to stand out amongst other applicants is to write about something you have built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

We are hiring Customer Success Engineers to help our self-serve and Corporate customers become successful, independent users of Roboflow. You will have direct input on the evolution of this role, the Customer Success Engineering function, and how Roboflow enables an increasingly large community of computer vision practitioners.

If you enjoy teaching technical concepts, building programs and content, and finding scalable ways to help customers succeed, let’s have a chat.

What You’ll Do

Roboflow's product-led growth customers are building an enormous variety of computer vision applications. Customer Success powers up those customers with the technical knowledge, best practices, and structured enablement they need to expand how they use Roboflow and confidently progress from experimentation into production.

The function operates through two complementary enablement models:

Scalable enablement — recurring webinars, onboarding sessions, technical workshops, clinics, office hours, learning journeys, and reusable educational content designed to help large numbers of self-serve customers progress independently.
Targeted 1:1 enablement — structured, time-bound delivery of the Targeted Enablement Option Pack for qualifying Corporate customers who need additional guidance through core Roboflow functionality.

The objective isn't to do the customer's work for them; it is to remove educational friction and give customers the knowledge, tools, and confidence to progress independently.

You will teach customers how to work effectively with datasets, annotations, model training and evaluation, and the wider Roboflow platform. Just as importantly, you will identify recurring points of friction and turn them into programs and reusable assets that can benefit hundreds or thousands of future customers.

Role And Responsibilities

Develop, deliver, and continually improve technical enablement programs for Roboflow's self-serve customer base, covering platform onboarding, annotation strategy and quality, dataset management, model training and evaluation, workflows and deployments and workspace administration
Host bi-weekly webinars, technical workshops, office hours, and other live educational sessions
Develop learning journeys that guide customers towards increasingly sophisticated use of Roboflow technology

new_jobs.description:
About Hyperbound

Deals are messy. Multiple stakeholders, hours of calls, and endless emails. At Hyperbound, we're building the AI Agent that will help sales teams untangle that mess.

Hyperbound is the Revenue Activation Platform: an agentic OS for sales that connects what happens to what should happen next.

We came out of YC S23 and went viral with Voice Agents that reps could call to put their skills to the test. Today, we’re building AI that understands sales conversations, coaches in real time, reasons across deals, and takes action to move them forward.

We are trusted by companies like IBM, LinkedIn, Amazon, Bloomberg, Supabase, Monday.com, Notion, and Vanta. We raised a $15M Series A in October 2025, grew ARR 5× over the past year, and are growing nearly 20% month over month.

About The Role

You'll own a book of 25 to 40 mid-market customers ($20k to $100k+ ARR) and be their day-to-day owner at Hyperbound. Your job is to get them live, get their reps using the product.

What We Need From You

Technical depth: You can debug, trace and reproduce a bug. You go to product or engineering when a problem is below the UI, not because you didn't want to look.
Relationship instinct: You know the key people at every account, they know you, and they message you before they message anyone else. You understand what each customer is trying to fix and you build the plan around that.
Ownership: When something goes wrong, you name the problem, and start solving it. You only pull in more people if required.
Conviction: You push back. When a customer wants to skip the rollout plan, run the wrong cadence, or launch to the whole sales org on day one, you tell them why it won't work and sell them on the approach that will. Customers respect solutions that are sold to them, not handed over. You own the implementation and the outcome, not just the setup.

Highly Preferred

Background in sales enablement, revenue enablement, or GTM ops. You've rolled out a tool or a methodology to a sales team before and know what it takes to get reps to actually use it.
Experience implementing or administering Hyperbound or a similar sales coaching platform.

What Your Regular Thursday Looks Like

Implementation: Own the project plan from kickoff to first live cohort. Rollout design, integrations setup, SSO and SCIM, admin training, launch date.
Adoption: Regular check-ins, usage reviews, feature demos, and behaviour-change plays that get reps practising and managers coaching.
First-line technical support: Discovery on the call, reproduce the issue, file a clean ticket. Solve what can be solved in the UI or a playbook yourself.
Voice of the customer: Own feedback from your accounts and make sure it reaches the product.
Health monitoring: Watch active users, caller counts, and implementation milestones so you act on a slipping account weeks before the renewal conversation, not during it.
Commercial signals: Spot expansion and renewal risk, log it, and hand it to the account manager who owns pricing and paper.
Responsiveness: Fast on Slack, tickets, and email.

What This Role Is Not

A tag-team job. You go to customer meetings alone. Bringing a second person is the exception.
A sales job. Retention comes first. Expansion signals get logged and handed over, not chased. A commercial role. You don't price, negotiate, or own renewal paper. You will be paired with an expansion Account manager who will take care of that.

Requirements

Comfortable with the technical side: reading logs, reproducing bugs, working through configuration, and explaining a technical issue clearly to both a customer and an engineer. You don't need to be an engineer.
You broadly understand how a sales team runs: quotas, onboarding, coaching cadences.
You remove blockers yourself rather than routing customers to another team.
You can run around 40 accounts and treat them differently on purpose

Interview Plan

30 min call with James, Recruiter
30 min call with Keshav, Product Lead
Take home exercise (1-3 hours)
Take home exercise review call (45 min)
Final interview with Co Founders and team

Compensation And Benefits

Series A equity
Medical, dental, and vision benefits
Unlimited PTO
Free lunch and dinner in the office
Commuter benefits

We move fast, from first conversation to offer in 1-2 weeks
